title: Service Early-Payment Record and the Fleet Late Balance Fee
content:
Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. A buyer who pays service invoices early earns an early-payment record share on the fleet late balance fee. The record read is the buyer's service ledger with Service Accounts and Repair Orders, specifically its early-payment discount credits.

**Clause.**
- Where the buyer's service ledger shows **at least 3** early-payment discount credits in the last 12 whole months before the handling date, the share is **0.85 (85 percent)**.
- Where it shows **one or more but fewer than 3**, the share is **0.95 (95 percent)**.
- Otherwise no early-payment record share applies.

A service ledger entry falls in the last 12 whole months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed from its ledger date to the handling date. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

| Early-payment discount credits on the service ledger, last 12 whole months | Early-payment record share |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.85 |
| 2 | 0.95 |
| 1 | 0.95 |
| 0 | none |

**Hypothetical window check.** The handling date is 10 March. An early-payment discount credit dated 11 March of the previous year falls inside the window: only 11 whole months have passed, because the 11th has not yet been reached in the twelfth month. A credit dated 10 March of the previous year is 12 whole months old and falls outside.

Only credits recorded with the early-payment discount as their reason count. Other service credits on the ledger do not count toward the 3.
